report.assessment: The available evidence shows two action-level upstream microbiological (relative_bioburden_signal) excursions on consecutive real batches of Famotidine Injection, USP on LINE-A: BATCH-075 on 2024-12-01 (LAB-0225 = 1.23 x action limit; open high-severity deviation DEV-0003) and BATCH-084 on 2025-01-04 (LAB-0255 = 1.48 x action limit, available exactly at the 2025-01-04T12:25Z cutoff). Both manufacturing days also show alert-level environmental monitoring results in the same 'process support area' (EM-0075 = 0.71; EM-0085 = 0.86, the highest EM result in the scoped package) and alert-level adjacent upstream draws (PRE-LAB-001 = 0.79; PRE-LAB-002 = 0.82). BATCH-075's finished product passed sterility ('no growth') and endotoxin (0.1326 of specification) and the batch was released 2024-12-16 and first shipped 2025-01-02 while DEV-0003 remains open; BATCH-084 is in progress with no finished-product results, no disposition and no deviation record as of the cutoff. No equipment failure, corrective maintenance or operator anomaly coincides with either excursion, and all historian values were within their expected bands on both days. Four competing explanations remain open and none is established: a recurring environmental/upstream condition (supported by the same-area EM co-signal and recurrence across batches), a sampling/handling artifact (supported by large certified within-batch sample disagreement: 0.44 and 0.66 between draws five minutes apart), a laboratory assay artifact (no QC records exist in the package to test it), and a data/recording artifact (contradicted by verified canonical values; the screening anomaly flags (uniformly of the clock-quality missing_source_time type) and malformed scanned-PDF timestamps are documented export/scan artifacts). Discriminating checks are proposed: independent re-testing of retained upstream samples, organism identification/typing, area trend and differential-pressure records, VESSEL-01 cleaning history, and assay QC review. The recurrence determination, any new deviation for BATCH-084, and all disposition decisions belong to human quality review; this investigation does not approve or execute any regulated action. Submission status: this report is filed as a partial investigation. The deterministic layer verified all six calculated metrics and all but eight cited observations against immutable originals; the eight unverified citations are OCR-extracted lines from the scanned lab review PDF and lines of the package manifest, which the available tooling cannot re-verify mechanically (OCR re-extraction is non-deterministic and the verifier has no JSON reader), so they require human source review of the original documents. All findings, coverage dispositions and citations are preserved unchanged pending that review.

report.cross_scope_synthesis: The scoped package covers 85 batches (BATCH-075 and BATCH-084 plus 83 synthetic context batches) across 14 sources: canonical structured exports (batch records, LIMS export, environmental monitoring, microbiology xlsx, historian, operator events, maintenance work orders, deviations), three display/scan duplicates (lims_review_local.csv with UTC-07 and percent-of-limit display aliases, an image-only scanned lab review with seeded OCR noise, and a discrete process event chart), a source-review PDF, and a package manifest documenting the conventions. Shared patterns: (1) every one of the 1189 screening anomaly flags is a missing_source_time clock-quality artifact - the analysis projection could not resolve a source-clock basis for the laboratory, environmental, historian and review exports, so no temporal ordering in this report is deterministically certified; all event times are transcribed source timestamps. (2) The two real batches share a tight abnormality signature on their manufacturing days: a certified action-level upstream bioburden result (1.23 and 1.48 times the 1.0 action limit, a 20.33% rise), an alert-level adjacent upstream draw five minutes later (0.79 and 0.82), and an alert-level environmental monitoring result in the same 'process support area' (0.71 and 0.86, a 21.13% rise, the latter the highest of 85 scoped EM results). (3) The same signal family appears at lower amplitude in the synthetic comparators (SYN-0004 1.08 and SYN-0014 1.06 at action level without elevated EM or deviations; SYN-0018/0029/0032 at alert level with EM co-elevation), so elevated readings alone are not unprecedented - but BATCH-075 and BATCH-084 are the only batches combining an action-level upstream result with an alert-level EM result, and their excursions are the two largest. Exceptions and limits: BATCH-075's finished product passed sterility and endotoxin and was released and shipped while its high-severity deviation DEV-0003 remains open; BATCH-084 is in progress with no finished-product results, no deviation record and no disposition as of the cutoff, and its action-level result became available exactly at the cutoff. No equipment failure, corrective maintenance, out-of-range historian value or operator anomaly coincides with either excursion; the only near-margin equipment signals are differential_pressure_margin 0.9615 (vs 1.0, severity 'low') on 2024-12-01 and hold_duration_margin 0.95 (vs 1.0, severity 'low') on 2025-01-04, both within band. The record duplicates corroborate transcription consistency, not measurement independence, and the package contains no organism identifications, no assay QC records, no sampling SOP and no area trend data - the four discriminating evidence classes that would separate the competing explanations. The specialist sub-investigation (em-organism-reviewer) confirmed the EM distribution facts independently and honestly reported that its retrieval share was exhausted before its text searches; the lead completed those checks with reserved calls, and corrected one numeric discrepancy in the subreport (SYN-0040 EM result 0.0599 vs the directly observed 0.2711). Root cause remains unresolved among the four competing hypotheses; no causal direction is inferred from the temporal association between the excursions, the EM results and the open deviation, and all disposition and recurrence decisions remain with human quality review.
